subject: Request: vendor onboarding — invoice lane consolidation & accelerated pay option
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@lumenix.com>

Cc: procurement@lumenix.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Adjust payment terms & early pay enrollment for onboarding

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the smooth onboarding call this morning. Lumenix is ready to activate the PO but we have one ask around payment terms: our standard is Net 45, and given the timing of our first milestone invoice we were hoping Redwood could set the invoice lane to Net 30 for the first 90 days so we can align cashflow for the project ramp. Separately, we would like to opt into your early-pay program (invoice discount) if that is available for new vendors — please let us know what rate tiers you offer and any eligibility cutoffs.

Quick answers to help you:
- Legal entity: Lumenix, Inc.
- Tax ID: (on W9) — attached
- Preferred remit method: ACH (will provide bank stub)

Can you confirm the following: 1) whether AP can accept Net 30 for the first three invoices, and 2) how to enroll in early-pay and what the timeline looks like? We need to hit the PO activation this Friday if possible.

Thanks,

Samantha Lee
Head of Finance Operations
Lumenix, Inc.
attachments: Lumenix_W9.pdf, Lumenix_BankInfo.redacted.txt
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Adjust payment terms & early pay enrollment for onboarding

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the W9. Looping in Marissa (procurement ops) and Jordan (finance ops) so we can confirm eligibility and timing fast.

Short answers up front:
- We can make an exception to set the first three invoices to Net 30 while we complete supplier validation, provided AP receives the onboarding form and a bank stub (we have the W9).
- Early-pay enrollment is possible via our accelerated-remit program; terms depend on volume and payment timing. Typical tiering is 1.0% for 7-day pay, 0.5% for 14-day, and 0.25% for 21-day (subject to final qualification).

Next steps (requested by EOD Wed to hit Friday activation):
1) Please submit the completed Supplier_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (I've attached our blank) and confirm bank stub (redacted is fine).
2) If you want to be considered for accelerated remit, indicate preferred discount tier (7/14/21 day) and which invoices you'd like to enroll.
3) Marissa/Jordan: once supplier form + bank stub are in, can procurement/AP fast-track the vendor record and set the first three invoices to Net 30?

I attached the onboarding form and included a short checklist below. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Checklist (what we need to finalize):
- Completed onboarding form (supplier contact, tax, remit)
- Bank stub for ACH confirmation (redacted account # ok)
- Preferred early-pay tier (if enrolling)

Thanks — I will hold the PO activation slot pending confirmation.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- Supplier form and W9 are complete and valid. Bank stub verified for ACH (account masked).
- Procurement will create the vendor record today and route the first three invoices to Net 30 as requested.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Samantha — we'll send the PO number and the expected payment dates as soon as payments are scheduled.
